items.caption:
55% have known they were dreaming.
A 2016 meta-analysis of 34 studies estimated that about 55% of people report having had at least one lucid dream (knowing you are dreaming, inside the dream), and 25 studies put monthly-or-more at about 23%. These are pooled estimates; the studies used different questions and samples, so treat them as rough.
